scope: Test-only native allocation and graph admission on six local OS processes, two partitions with three voters each.

independent_review.source_review: Separate reviewer read all five changed test/harness APIs. Parent reviewed final exact Life/Value assertions and native inspection delta after review; no production code changed.
semantic_checks: Child-owned Acquire and Next issue finite disjoint cached ranges and reject exhaustion.
Actual pre-quorum and post-quorum source SIGKILL, same-directory restart and native replacement election distinguish uncertain reservations using completed own ReadIndex and committed overwrite.
Delayed completed HOME acknowledgement after recipient replacement refuses; unknown committed blocks remain burned and new issuance starts above their high-water mark.
Stale unused Entity, Life and Value claims refuse without graph or CDC changes; current authority controls apply and exact Life/Value identities are inspected on all target voters.
Exact committed graph retries retain original identity, index and outcome without duplicate CDC; changed payload under the same request key refuses.
Old certified At reads preserve original typed values and component bytes after allocator and recipient restart; service-only rotation leaves surviving cached authority valid.
independent_review.negative_control: Isolated omission of recipient-session validation compiles and fails by accepting stale Node23/Life24. This is sensitivity evidence, not an original production bug.
independent_review.static_checks: Formatting, build, vet, pinned lint and gosec pass. govulncheck reports zero called vulnerable symbols; two imported-package and two required-module advisories remain.
independent_review.coverage: Fresh scoped profiles only; no new public API or changed production. Prior accepted production coverage carries by exact source identity. Full combined hosted coverage remains pending.
independent_review.resources: Every local Go invocation bounded by 180 seconds and 4 GiB aggregate process-tree RSS; Go 1.26.9, GOMAXPROCS=2, GOMEMLIMIT=2GiB, GOFLAGS=-p=1, GOWORK=off. Docker scanners capped at 4 GiB and 2 CPUs; host wrapper RSS is not container memory measurement.

companion: Completed native range-move guard was separately integrated as f1952b08 and scoped in 7eeebafd; its in-process tests are not included in this process inventory.
qualifications: Earlier failed compiler and fixture-setup probes are retained in the raw archive and classified in QUALIFICATIONS.json; they are not production semantic failures.
Local OS-process crashes and same-directory restarts do not establish physical host or power-loss durability.
MaxUint64 boundary remains the existing reducer/codec check, not a native graph high-water setup.
Logical graph creation, lost-storage recreation and member replacement admission remain open.
No full V2, engine-selection, comparative capacity or release acceptance.
